card.name: Last digit of a decimal number
card.fires_on: A single digit, usually 5 or 0 or 1, that ends a decimal or number with two decimal places or digits, such as 2.25, 6.25, 3.50 or 7,500.

modes.label: Final 5 in x.x5
modes.description: The digit 5 closes a two-decimal quantity, often a dose in mg or g.
modes.example: ERBAXA 18.75 mg/kg Provides 12.5 mg/kg ceftolozane and 6.2<<5>> mg/kg tazobactam.

modes.label: Final 0 in prices or counts
modes.description: The digit 0 ends a price or a number with commas.

modes.label: Final 1 in a percentage
modes.description: The digit 1 ends a two-decimal percentage figure.
modes.example: hit 9.3<<1>>% efficiency with polymer-based organic photovolta

card.plain: It marks the last digit of a number written with two decimal places, like 2.25 g or $3.50.
